title: Model coverage gaps playbook and competitive recon pipeline
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: create an operational playbook and automated pipeline to detect model capability coverage gaps across product verticals, prioritize competitive threats, and generate actionable research tasks for PM/Eng. Use a mix of automated telemetry (latency, regression rates, cost-per-inference), discrete evals on representative prompts, and market scouting for new model entrants. Deliverables: 1) prioritized gap catalog by customer archetype, 2) automated weekly reconciled competitive snapshot, 3) a templated research runbook linking to evals and PRs.
acceptance_criteria: Weekly pipeline produces a ranked list of top 25 coverage gaps with metrics (latency/accuracy/cost) for each customer archetype
Integration with evaluation harness to attach a minimal reproducible prompt set for each gap
Automated scan flags new model entrants and surfaces replacement candidates with cost/latency estimates
Playbook includes triage criteria, owner assignments, and suggested remediation paths (quantization, variant routing, model pin)
Stakeholder review completed with PM, Eng, and Customer Success and sign-off recorded
tasks: Design canonical customer archetypes and map to representative prompt families
Define telemetry signals and thresholds for coverage-gap classification
Wire eval harness to nightly job that runs against top-10 candidate models
Prototype ranking heuristic combining accuracy delta, latency delta, and cost delta
Build a UI slice in Console (draft) that displays gaps and suggested actions
Draft playbook doc and circulate for review
Schedule stakeholder review and incorporate feedback
